paper.title: OceanNet: a principled neural operator-based digital twin for regional oceans
paper.conclusion_note: The 26 staging claims were checked against the published article and the paginated author manuscript. This is not a complete-paper extraction or code audit. The supplement was inspected separately and cannot silently substitute for the main paper.

primary_paper.edition_note: Paginated author manuscript used for locators; published Scientific Reports 14:21181 HTML was checked independently. These are distinct editions.

claims.extracted_value: Regional SSH forecasting of Gulf Stream and Loop Current eddies
claims.evidence_summary: The authors define regional SSH forecasting for Loop Current eddies and Gulf Stream meanders.
claims.audit_note: The task and region are explicit.

claims.extracted_value: Northwest Atlantic regional ROMS reanalysis with EnKF assimilation
claims.evidence_summary: The regional reanalysis is produced with ROMS and EnKF in the northwest Atlantic.
claims.audit_note: Dataset identity and origin are explicit.

claims.evidence_summary: The FNO receives a historical five-day mean SSH state.
The predicted output is a future SSH state.
The reported training years are 1993 through 2018.
The reported test years are 2019 through 2020.

claims.extracted_value: Training uses five-day-mean SSH; Gulf of Mexico 5-day lead, Gulf Stream 4-day lead
claims.locator: Data description and forecast lead text
claims.evidence_summary: Five-day input averaging and two distinct regional forecast leads are reported.
claims.audit_note: The field merges temporal averaging with two experiment-specific leads under one generic experiment. Split the statements.

claims.extracted_value: Underlying regional ROMS reanalysis: 4 km horizontal and 50 vertical layers
claims.evidence_summary: The source reanalysis has 4 km horizontal spacing and 50 vertical layers.
claims.audit_note: Horizontal resolution and layer count remain distinguished.

claims.extracted_value: Fourier neural operator with predictor-evaluate-corrector time integrator
claims.evidence_summary: The method combines an FNO tendency with predictor-evaluate-corrector integration.
Four Fourier layers are stated within the FNO.
claims.audit_note: The value 4 needs the qualifier Fourier layers; it is not the total network layer count.

claims.evidence_summary: Each Fourier layer uses 64 retained modes.
claims.audit_note: The value needs the per-layer qualifier.

claims.evidence_summary: The FNO is reported to have approximately 80 million parameters.
claims.audit_note: Parameter count and model scope are preserved.

claims.extracted_value: Two convolutions lift input state to latent channels
claims.evidence_summary: Figure 6 depicts two convolutional lifting operations.

claims.extracted_value: Two convolutions map latent features to forecast state
claims.evidence_summary: Figure 6 depicts two convolutional projections to the output state.
The time stepping is given as a predictor-evaluate-corrector update.
The MSE is evaluated at ocean points.
claims.audit_note: Masked wording retains the ocean-only scope.

claims.extracted_value: Penalty on mismatch of latitude-averaged zonal Fourier spectra for selected wavenumbers
claims.evidence_summary: The spectral loss compares zonal spectra averaged across latitude above a threshold wavenumber.

claims.extracted_value: Spectral coefficient lambda included in combined two-step loss; numeric lambda not transcribed
claims.evidence_summary: A symbolic lambda multiplies the spectral term.
claims.audit_note: The clause about numeric lambda is an extraction note embedded in the scientific value. Record symbolic coefficient separately; numeric value requires scoped absence review, and code was not inspected.

claims.evidence_summary: The objective sums loss contributions from two forecast steps.
The authors set k_T to 100 after experiments.

claims.extracted_value: Reduced state dynamics dX/dt=F(X(t)); F approximated by FNO
claims.evidence_summary: The state tendency dX/dt is written as F(X), parameterized by an FNO.

claims.extracted_value: Physics-inspired learned tendency/integrator and spectral regularization; not demonstrated PDE-residual PINN
claims.evidence_summary: The named components are present; the negative PINN classification is an interpretation.
claims.audit_note: Keep this as AI_INTERPRETATION and do not promote it to author fact.

extracted_value: modified Hausdorff distance for eddy shape
claims.locator: Metric definitions and figure captions, manuscript pp. 4-10
claims.evidence_summary: RMSE, correlation coefficient and modified Hausdorff distance are reported.

claims.extracted_value: Forecast skill reported up to 90-120 days; substantially faster runtime than regional dynamical model
claims.locator: Skill and computational-cost paragraphs, manuscript pp. 4-10
claims.evidence_summary: The authors report skill over roughly 90 to 120 days and about 500,000-fold runtime acceleration.
claims.audit_note: The staging wording is less precise but supported.

claims.extracted_value: No explicit lateral open-ocean boundary condition
claims.evidence_summary: The authors identify the missing lateral open-ocean boundary condition as a major shortcoming.

claims.extracted_value: Add additional prognostic variables and address long-term/open-boundary regimes
claims.evidence_summary: The authors discuss added prognostic variables and boundary issues as future work.
claims.audit_note: The value is supported, but AUTHOR_REPORTED_FUTURE_WORK is outside the project provenance enum; correction is required.

unresolved: No complete-paper field-by-field extraction review is documented.
The official published HTML, paginated arXiv v2 manuscript and supplementary PDF are distinct source editions.
The GitHub code repository was declared but not inspected or executed.
No new NOT_REPORTED finding is asserted for uninspected code or unresolved fields.
